TC-02/S14.title: AI check: a hard-to-read name is flagged, not guessed (dev)
TC-02/S14.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727), dataset lane pl-tc02 (QA_TARGET=dev scripts/datasets/run.sh pl-tc02 under runs/.dev.lock, Quinn's saved session, 2026-10-17 01:01–01:04 JST), real vision model. Raw scanCensusSheet rows read from the page's own socket (ActionResponse of the scan request), diagnostics:list for model and timing. Media rendered for this package (cases/fixtures/pl-tc02/media h-u1..5 / n-u1..5: ink blot, blur, scribble, faint, cut; the 5th row's name unreadable, 4 legible rows). h-u1 and n-u1 returned [] (3167 / 6208 ms); the other 8 not read after two empty reads; 3.2 threshold not countable. Known B01. Locally (S28) the app silently drops a row whose name comes back blank and has no 'unclear' flag at all, so this check would fail even after B01 is fixed unless the model writes a marker into the name.
